info.title: jj-store application API
info.description: Native JJ read and typed mutation contracts. Access is deployment-dependent: authenticated deployments require repository Bearer credentials, while LocalTrusted installations admit only protected literal-loopback requests and bind an installation principal. Tokens never appear in paths, query strings or cookies. Shared deployments require TLS. Numeric JSON values retain Rust widths: clients must handle precision beyond JavaScript safe integers explicitly.

get.description: Transport-protected deployment bootstrap. Exact authority, protocol-version, Origin and Fetch Metadata checks apply before this response. LocalTrusted repository entries are installation-owned discovery metadata, never repository authority. Authenticated deployments expose no repository catalog.

get.description: Requires current repository read permission. Only explicitly configured repositories advertise search. Search pins a native view and Tantivy generation, reauthorizes every page, and never publishes. q is required; at_op selects visible-commit mode, historical mode is explicit. All query inputs must match a continuation. Minimum-position waits are bounded; 409 index_lag includes authorized search_status. Expired/restarted cursors require reset. Indexed positions are distinct from current repository positions. Source strings are untrusted data.

post.description: Requires current repository write permission. The authenticated session supplies the actor and repository-bound publication identity. Apply returns a manifest-selected durable receipt or outcome_unknown; status reauthorizes and returns that receipt after restart. not_known never proves rejection. Stale review preconditions, changed retries and cross-principal identities fail without publication.

404.description: Object not committed in the selected snapshot or unknown route.

409.description: stale_snapshot, stale_bookmark, stale_conflict, protected_transition, reconciliation_required, no_changes, epoch_changed or intent_conflict. No publication by this rejected attempt.

410.description: Index task expired or was lost on server restart.

413.description: Request or response resource limit exceeded.

415.description: Unsupported request media type or content encoding.

503.description: Busy, unavailable, corrupt or incomplete history.

WalPosition.description: Publication order is distinct from native operation ancestry.

SearchDocument.description:
Owned extraction output. Native identity fields are stored exactly; the body
is indexed but never stored in query hits. Fetch source via an authorized ID.

repositories.description: False preserves a retired membership and its historical task targets.

body.description: None is an explicit tombstone; historical bodies stay in selected WAL roots.

CopyReference.description: A copy placeholder is not a content-addressed object or dependency.

terms.description:
Native alternating add/remove terms. A sole None means absence and is
excluded from directory listings; unresolved deletions remain explicit.

before.description: Native values at the target; source annotations never replace these.

result.description: Provisional native IDs; apply revalidates and may produce different IDs.

ConflictResolutionReport.description: Complete remaining native paths on the target and every changed result.
